system.description: As part of its Move Action, an Airborne Beast uses the Tumble ability of the Acrobatics skill to fly through a threatened area or the fighting space of an enemy without provoking an Attack of Opportunity. The Beast must make a successful DC 15 Acrobatics check and is considered Trained in Acrobatics for the purpose of using this Special Quality.
